profiles.notes: Reference dates differ by circuit (2004–2026); positions are map/photo-referenced approximations, not surveys. Eau Rouge/Raidillon ONLY uses the same photo-guided modern climb, kerbs and paved apron for every era, as explicitly requested; not historical or surveyed. Photo-audit refinement: La Source paved outer apron, short apex/exit kerbs; recent Spa red/yellow palette. Reference date differs from preset year; widths and placement are estimates. User follow-up: La Source paved island/escape; separate T5/T6/T7 apexes and green/gravel margins; right-left Bus Stop and green-edged finish straight. Authored extents, unchanged mapped road and pit alignment. Only the recent surface and its 2021 substitute use this correction.
